decision.case_state: Recurring solar-panel reading job for Flat 10, 180 Alder Lane. The January reading (16845) was received from the tenant and sent to the landlord (event 013). The landlord confirmed on 17 Jan that the next reading is due 15 September (event 015). The ticket is on hold until 2025-09-01 for the next photo request.

next_actions.action: Acknowledged the landlord's reply and confirmed the next reading is due 15 September, with the photo to be requested in good time.
Thanked the tenant for the reading, said it has been passed to the landlord, and said the next reading is due 15 September.
Scheduled a follow-up on 2025-09-01 to request the tenant's photo ahead of 15 September.

boundaries: Sending the landlord's reading does not confirm the reading is correct beyond what the photo shows.
Having the next date does not confirm the tenant will send the photo in September.
The ticket is not closed: it is a recurring job.
remaining_work: On 2025-09-01, request a clear photo of the solar reading from the tenant ahead of the 15 September reading date, then send it to the landlord. Owner: agency operations.
missing_info: The tenant's and landlord's email addresses are not in the case files; replies used the existing threads.
decision.summary: The January reading was received and sent to the landlord, who has now said the next reading is due 15 September rather than mid June. I acknowledged this with the landlord, thanked the tenant, returned the job to auto mode and put it on hold with a follow-up on 1 September to request the next photo.

answers.question: Where does this case stand right now, and what is outstanding?
answers.answer: The January reading was received and sent to the landlord. The landlord has confirmed the next reading is due 15 September 2025. Outstanding: the tenant's photo for the September reading, to be requested on 1 September 2025.

answers.question: What is the next action, who is it for, and through which channel?
answers.answer: Acknowledge the landlord (Ava) and thank the tenant (Miles Fletcher) by email on the existing threads. Then wait until 1 September and request the tenant's photo by email.

answers.question: Does anything need a human decision, and why?
answers.answer: No. The landlord's change of date is a scheduling update from the entitled party, not a spend or policy decision, so it is recorded and acted on without escalation.

actions_claimed.description: Email to landlord Ava confirming the 15 September next reading date
Email to tenant Miles Fletcher thanking him and noting the next reading date
Ticket NBL-010-recurring returned to auto mode
Follow-up FUP-103 set for 2025-09-01 to request the tenant's photo
Ticket on hold until 2025-09-01 for the photo request

failed_actions.handling: First resume_auto used the case label 010-recurring, which was not found. Retried with the real ref NBL-010-recurring from list_tickets, which verified as A4.

conflicts: Initial request said the next reading was due mid June; the landlord's latest message (event 015, 17 Jan) says 15 September. I followed the landlord's later instruction.

Event 013 refers to attachment-80-document, but the file on the case is attachment-01 (the solar meter photo). The landlord acknowledged receipt in event 015, so I treated the photo as delivered. The reading 16845 is taken from the file on the case.
The ticket reference in the system is NBL-010-recurring, not 010-recurring.
assumptions: The meter reading in the photo file (16845) is the one the tenant sent, as the landlord acknowledged it.
The 1 September review date allows time to request the photo ahead of 15 September.
